p1: For a whole year, a stranger was living inside his closet. He had no idea.
It sounds like an urban legend. It's not. Japan, 2008.
A man keeps noticing food disappearing from his kitchen.
So he sets up security cameras that send pictures to his phone.
One day, while he's out, his phone shows someone moving inside his house.
He calls the police. But the door is locked. Every window is closed.
Then they slide open the top compartment of a bedroom closet.
And there she is. Curled up on her side.
A 58-year-old woman. She'd slipped in a year earlier, through a door he left unlocked.
She'd moved in a mattress. Police said she even took showers.
She told them she had nowhere to live. She was arrested for trespassing.
So... when did you last check the top of your closet? Follow for more true stories.
